story.title: The missing wooden doll
paragraphs_en: Once upon a time there was a silly girl called Lathika. People called her Laughable Lathika . She used to make funny faces and make sad people cheerful again. She loved to talk to her friends when they were sick and sad . She had a favourite toy, a little wooden doll.

One sunny day Lathika was cheering up a sick friend and she went to take her wooden doll and it was not there but Lathika was not affected she said- " I know it will be here let me go to my room." But it was not there it used to be on the little shelf what her dad built for her. Lathika said in a cheerful voice-" hahaha dad must have hid it let me go ask him"

Lathika went to her living room and saw her brother Lakshman and her Father Ram she used to think she was in the Ramayana because her brother and her father s names are from the characters of the epic Ramayana. Then she said- "dad did you take my wooden doll please I really want it!" Her father scolded- "No lathika i have not seen it and you are 10 years old you have to take care of your things! Her 5 year old brother followed- "Yes lathika always take care of your things!

Lathika sat by the window and sighed this is the first time she was sad! She thought to herself- "where could it be?" Then her mom came in a cheerful voice she asked-" lathika did you see so many people eating my tasty fresh hot gulab jamun?" Lathika said in a sad voice- "Nice mummy you make the best sweets in town...." Her mom said-" ohhh Lathika my beautiful girl what is wrong?" Lathika murmured- "m... my doll i-is missing."

Her mother gasped-"What really?!" Then lathika said in a strict voice- "why will I be joking mummy!!!!" Then her mother started chuckling-" ohhh latika what day is it?" Lathika annoyed said-"what mummy my birthday?!" Her mother said smilng- April fooled hahaha! oh my god lathika how can you fall for this!" Lathika s eyes grew wide and opened her mouth wide it looked like she was about to scream but then it was just a loud laugh HAHAHAHAHAHA

Her mom said- "your dad was also in this and even your little brother!" Lathika said-"then where is my doll?" Her mother handed it to her. Then our cheerful lathika was back on track. She hugged her family and all was well she enjoyed this day.
